_what: When the stored bytes of a file the person deleted for good leave the place that keeps them, read by src/namespace-byte-release.mjs (the store's part) and src/namespace.mjs releaseGoneBytes (the part that removes objects). A file is a candidate only once Recently Deleted forgets it for good (src/namespace-set-aside.mjs sweep), never because it has no name: some files are held by identity on purpose. `holders` are the places that keep a file in use: while any row in one of them names the file (by any of its identities), its bytes stay. A new kind of holder is one row. `every_hours` is how often a pass runs per person; `continue_after_seconds` is the wait between pages of one pass while work is left; `candidates_per_page` and `keys_per_page` bound each page. `recorded_margin_seconds` covers clocks that differ between the Worker and the store: bytes written for an upload are only recorded when no release of the same key was claimed or finished after the write began, minus this margin. `claim_stale_minutes` is how long a removal that never reported back stays claimed before it is tried again.

holders.why: a name in Recently Deleted or Archived whose days are not over
a move to another store in progress

_rules: Release rules (src/namespace-release-rules.mjs): a person's own rows, kept as the setting `release_rules`, each { id, label, on, when, after_days, storage_above_bytes, order }. `when` is a formula-engine rule tree over `item_facts` (the same facts and ids the Recently Deleted screen filters by); null covers everything in Recently Deleted and Archived. after_days gives a matching item's storage back that many days after it was deleted, sooner than its keep-for when that is shorter; storage_above_bytes gives back matching items, `order` first, while the bytes kept are above it. Keep-for (the setting keep_for, src/namespace-set-aside.json) stays the longest anything waits. `forecast_days` is how far ahead the storage screen draws what leaves; `rules_most` bounds a person's rows; `orders` are the ways storage rules pick first. `after_days_choices` and `storage_choices_bytes` are what the storage screen offers to pick.
